title: fagara khasyana
intro: Fagara khasyana, commonly known as the 'Nagakesar' or 'Indian Bitters', is a plant species in the Rutaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Fagara khasyana include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antibacterial agent, which helps in treating fever, pain, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Fagara khasyana include limonoids, coumarins, and flavonoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
